proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our center console had gone so chalky it left white on your hand. Desmond did a test patch by the bow first so we could see it, then did the whole hull at our dock behind the house. Neighbors asked if we bought a new boat.
reviews.name: Priscilla M.

reviews.text: Black SUV, parked outside two blocks from the beach. Salt spots and swirls everywhere. After the correction and coating, rain just runs off it, and washing takes ten minutes.
reviews.name: Rashad T.

reviews.text: A palm frond hit my hood during a summer storm and left a dent and a long scratch. They dealt with my insurance, pushed the dent out and polished the scratch so it doesn't show at all.
reviews.name: Noemi R.

reviews.text: We come down every November and the car sits under a carport all summer. Booked a correction the week we got back. The paint looks deeper than when we left it in April.
reviews.name: Harold J.

reviews.text: Got side-swiped on Federal Highway. They explained I could pick my own shop, sent the photos the same afternoon, and the door matches the fender even in that harsh noon light.
reviews.name: Yesenia F.

reviews.text: Fishing boat on a trailer, rails and deck badly hazed. They coated it after the restoration and it came through the whole rainy season still slick.
reviews.name: Calvin E.

proof.guarantee: Coating, correction and gel coat work: if any spot fails in the first 2 years, we come back and fix it.
